title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30240: add event before adding price list lines
summary: A cancellable event is added before price list line creation so extensions can implement custom logic or replace the standard line creation behavior.
key_points: New OnBeforeAddLine event added to Price List Management.AddLine procedure
Event includes relevant price records and an IsHandled parameter
Allows subscribers to bypass standard line creation
Enables extensibility for custom asset price list line handling
quote: Extensions need to replace the standard logic that creates a price list line for an asset when suggested price lines are added.
